In mathematics, a '''Mumford measure''' is a [[measure (mathematics)|measure]] on a [[supermanifold]] constructed from a bundle of relative dimension 1|1. It is named for [[David Mumford]].

*{{Citation | last1=Voronov | first1=Alexander A. | title=A formula for the Mumford measure in superstring theory |mr=947611 | year=1988 | journal=Funktsional'nyi Analiz i Ego Prilozheniya | volume=22 | issue=2 | pages=67–68}}
